name: Keycloak
subtitle: Self-hosted identity and access management
creator: Bill Burke and Stian Thorgersen at Red Hat
description: A full identity server you run yourself. It provides single sign-on across apps, OIDC, OAuth 2.0 and SAML, LDAP and Active Directory federation, social and enterprise identity brokering, MFA and a themeable login page.

languages.youWrite: Admin UI, JSON or REST API, plus any OIDC library

concepts.explanation: Isolated tenants with their own users and settings.
Sign in through Google, Azure AD and others.

codeSamples.label: JavaScript · keycloak-js

pros: CNCF governance plus Red Hat backing
cons: You operate upgrades, high availability and patches
Theming the login UI is clunky

pricing.summary: Free and open source. You pay for your own servers, or for Red Hat's supported build.
